title: polyad.astrivant.com Workload v1alpha1

apiVersion.description: API group and version of this custom resource: polyad.astrivant.com/v1alpha1.

activation.description: Control how repeated requests start a downstream workload or graph.

maxConcurrent.description: Maximum selected or running executions for parallel mode.

maxPending.description: Maximum retained pending requests admitted to the queue.

replicasPerActivation.description: Deployment or StatefulSet replicas in each daemon activation.

maxReplicas.description: Upper bound on the total daemon replicas reserved by concurrent pulses.

onDeadline.description: Report overdue admission or submit a timer pulse.

metadata.description: Pod metadata, including application labels, annotations and externally managed cleanup finalizers.

spec.description: Native Kubernetes Pod spec. Include containers and any resource requests, volumes, probes or lifecycle hooks. Daemon containers require startup, readiness and liveness probes; inherited graph placement also applies.

template.description: Kubernetes Pod template for graph-owned execution. Container commands, resource requests, volumes and probes are application-defined; the operator sets restart policy and inherited placement.

backoffLimit.description: Maximum Job retries before Kubernetes reports failure. Pod interruption may trigger replacement within this limit; retries can repeat application side effects.

additionalProperties.description: Value for an individual key in nodeSelector.

nodeSelector.description: Exact Kubernetes node-label matches, all of which must hold. Use labels for node groups or resource slices; cloud tags must first be exposed as node labels. Conflicting inherited values are rejected.

key.description: Node label or node field tested by this requirement.

operator.description: Selector comparison operator: In, NotIn, Exists, DoesNotExist, Gt or Lt.

values.description: Comparison values for this requirement. In and NotIn use a nonempty set; Exists and DoesNotExist use no values; Gt and Lt use one integer encoded as a string.

matchExpressions.description: Node-label requirements combined with AND within this term.

key.description: Node label or node field tested by this requirement.

operator.description: Selector comparison operator: In, NotIn, Exists, DoesNotExist, Gt or Lt.

values.description: Comparison values for this requirement. In and NotIn use a nonempty set; Exists and DoesNotExist use no values; Gt and Lt use one integer encoded as a string.

matchFields.description: Node-field requirements combined with AND within this term.

nodeSelectorTerms.description: Alternative node-selection terms combined with OR. Expressions within one term are combined with AND. An empty term selects no nodes.

requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExe.description: Hard node eligibility rules evaluated when scheduling. Changes to node labels after scheduling do not by themselves evict a running pod.

weight.description: Preference weight from 1 to 100. Matching preferred rules contribute to the node scheduling score.

preference.description: Node-selection term whose match contributes the associated weight.

preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringEx.description: Weighted node preferences applied after hard eligibility checks. Unmatched preferences do not prevent scheduling.

nodeAffinity.description: Required and preferred Kubernetes node-selection rules. Required rules intersect across graph, definition and pod scopes; preferences are combined.

key.description: Taint key to match. An empty key requires operator Exists and matches all keys.

operator.description: Taint comparison: Equal matches key and value; Exists matches the key regardless of value. Kubernetes defaults an omitted operator to Equal.

value.description: Taint value to match when operator is Equal. Omit or leave empty when operator is Exists.

effect.description: Taint effect to match. An empty effect matches all effects: NoSchedule, PreferNoSchedule and NoExecute.

tolerationSeconds.description: Seconds a pod may remain bound after a matching NoExecute taint. Omission tolerates that taint indefinitely; zero requests immediate eviction.

tolerations.description: Kubernetes taints tolerated by descendant pods, deduplicated across scopes. Tolerations allow placement on tainted nodes; they do not select or guarantee a node.

enforce.description: Keep these constraints in every descendant pod. False allows a more specific workload or graph placement to replace these defaults; an enforced ancestor cannot be relaxed.

placement.description: Placement defaults or enforced constraints copied to descendant pod templates. Tolerations permit matching taints; selectors and required affinity restrict eligible nodes. This does not reserve capacity.

persistence.description: Optional persistent storage contract. Storage does not checkpoint or resume application execution; use non-spot capacity.

enabled.description: Require an explicitly selected existing persistent volume claim.

storageClass.description: Required StorageClass name when enabled; must match the PVC storageClassName. The operator does not create StorageClasses.

claimName.description: Existing PVC in the workload namespace. External claims survive graph suspension, replacement and deletion.

mountPath.description: Absolute non-root path mounted in application and init containers.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: enabled persistence requires storageClass and claimName
